steps.label: 3304-own-lab-actual239-select-fifth-answer-local
command: (()=>{if(document.querySelector('#omrTypeSel').value!=='OBSACN')throw Error('OBSACN Lab only');const r=document.querySelector('#omrSlot [data-omr-code=OBSACN]'),s=window.omrSerializers.OBSACN.serialize(r),rows=r.querySelectorAll('.omr-obsacn-row');if(rows.length!==5||s.answer.allowed_answer[0].value!=='④')throw Error('Expected actual five-choice answer4');const b=rows[4].querySelector('input[type=radio]');if(!b||b.checked||b.matches(':disabled'))throw Error('Fifth answer radio unavailable');b.click();return {clickedFifth:true,cmsSave:false};})()

steps.label: 3312-own-lab-ai9382-fill-actual-times-text-json
command: (()=>{const f=window.__qaLabSavedOmrFixtures.find(e=>e.itemId===2089382);if(document.querySelector('#omrTypeSel').value!=='SBSANM'||f.questionType!=='SBSANM'||f.answer.allowed_answer[0].value_type!=='text'||!f.answer.allowed_answer[0].value.includes('TIMES'))throw Error('Actual AI text fixture required');for(const [id,value] of [['omrJsonIn',f.omr],['ansJsonIn',f.answer]]){const e=document.getElementById(id);e.value=JSON.stringify(value);e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}window.__qaLabActiveSourceItemId=f.itemId;return {sourceItemId:f.itemId,answer:f.answer};})()
